newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - June US T-bonds could return higher soon.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - June US T-bonds could return higher soon.

text.p: The June U.S. Treasury bond future could retest the upside soon if it continues to respect support near Wednesday's low, brokers and analysts said.
Lead-month futures at midmorning Wednesday hit a low of 107-28/32 as the market braced for the five-year T-note sale and after the overnight extension to a high of 108-11/32.
"This area (107-29/32) should hold, and we could catch a bid," said one T-bond futures floor broker who expected the contract to retest 108-07/32 after the five-year results.
"But if we can't go back up there or it's on no volume, then we could fail pretty hard," he added.
"Above 07 (108-07/32) really tells you it could go higher," agreed another floor broker, who pegged good intraday support in June T-bonds at 107-20/32 to 24/32.
But he said a successful return above 108-07/32 likely would slam into a wall near the seven-percent yield equivalent, which he pegged at about 108-31/32.
Interim trendline resistance stood at 108-11/32, chartists noted.
The first broker added that Tuesday's grind higher occurred on rising open interest, which increased an estimated 16,056 contracts, according to preliminary exchange records.

Hints that open interest is increasing again and volume picking up as prices rise suggest longs may be starting to accumulate "like they're buying them to hold," said Gerry DeMers, a technical analyst at Fuji Securities Inc.
He was impressed that the contract thus far Wednesday had held support spanning 107-30/32 to 24/32 and said it recently has "done a decent job of holding higher lows."
Other signs, including an upturn in weekly stochastics from very low levels that he said overshadowed a high daily reading, also suggest the short-term downtrend may be reversing.
"I'm a little bit constructive," DeMers said.

But DeMers also cautioned that nearby T-bond futures need to return above the key 108-07/32 level to keep buyers interested and promote a rise over the next few days toward 108-23/32 or higher as cash returns toward the seven-percent yield equivalent.
